baseline.cleanup_step_raw:
- name: Local cleanup
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          docker ps -aq --filter "ancestor=$IMAGE" | xargs -r docker rm -f
          docker image rm "$IMAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          rm -rf /tmp/porota-predeploy-app /tmp/porota-artifact-manifest.json /tmp/porota-host-control-plane.json /tmp/porota-dependency-repro.json /tmp/porota-host-manifest-v2.json /tmp/porota-host-policy-v2.json /tmp/porota-deploy-bundle-v2.tgz /tmp/porota-deploy-bundle-v2-manifest.json /tmp/porota-predeploy-image.tar.gz /tmp/porota-frozen-candidate.json /tmp/porota-governed-tests.xml /tmp/porota-governed-tests.json /tmp/porota-test-collection.txt /tmp/porota-test-exclusions.txt /tmp/porota-test-args.txt /tmp/porota-negative-fixtures.json "${RUNNER_TEMP}/porota-predeploy-evidence"
          rm -f POROTA_SOURCE_PROVENANCE.json /tmp/porota-source-provenance.json /tmp/porota-image-inspect.json /tmp/porota-bundle-byte-provenance.json /tmp/porota-image-tar-byte-provenance.json
          rm -f /tmp/porota-issue465-audit-gate.json
          rm -rf /tmp/porota-predeploy-published-evidence
          rm -f /tmp/porota-installed-dependencies.txt /tmp/porota-predeploy-origin.json
          rm -f /tmp/porota-final-input-provenance.json
          rm -f /tmp/porota-runtime-codec-smoke.json
          rm -f /tmp/porota-convergence-input-inventory.json
          echo 'POROTA_PREDEPLOY_LOCAL_CLEANUP=GREEN'
findings: set +e and ignored removal failures followed by unconditional cleanup GREEN
ancestor filter can include containers not created by this run
shared fixed temporary paths have no UUID/root ownership marker
overall Predeploy GREEN is emitted before always cleanup
cleanup does not measure filesystem free bytes/inodes before and after

developed_contract.free_space: per filesystem free bytes and free inodes before/after; signed delta and max(0,delta), not causal shared-layer attribution
developed_contract.output: exclusive PENDING receipt reserved/fsynced outside private root before mutations; replaced by measured GREEN/RED receipt
developed_contract.owner: current euid + private UUID marker + root dev/inode/mount id + source hash + full image labels + actual ImageID
developed_contract.partial_build: explicit STARTED phase; missing capture never means no build; only complete own-label binding permits removal
developed_contract.private_files: bounded fd-relative NOFOLLOW/NOATIME inventory; nlink/uid/type/dev/mount id; external source manifest exact claimed identity/hash
developed_contract.shared_image: retain and RED if foreign tags/digests/references prevent scoped removal; no force image removal
developed_contract.stress_producer: only governed collection/execution receive RUNNER_TEMP=POROTA_PREDEPLOY_TMP; global RUNNER_TEMP remains owner-control parent
developed_contract.workflow_order: primary upload -> replay -> secondary upload/API check -> always cleanup -> success + cleanup-receipt gated summary
